challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: I am reviewing the infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack and the cost has doubled. I am prepared to accept a lower level of logging detail for the drift checks if that brings the spend back within budget. The granular observability data is a luxury we cannot sustain right now. I am willing to give up the fine grained signal to keep the platform running without a major funding escalation.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up granular observability data to stay within budget, indicating an acceptance of loss in one area to preserve another.
